a.lede: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. [...]
a.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data

b.lede: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies. [...]
b.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
